title.en: The Frogs Who Wished for a King
title.tet: Manduku Sira ne'ebé Husu Liurai Ida

description.tet: Antes atu troka, hanoin lai di'ak ka aat.

description.ko: 변화를 원하기 전에 현재보다 더 나아질지 먼저 생각하라.

original_text:
The Frogs were tired of governing themselves. They had so much freedom that it had spoiled them, and they did nothing but sit around croaking in a bored manner and wishing for a government that could entertain them with the pomp and display of royalty, and rule them in a way to make them know they were being ruled. No milk and water government for them, they declared. So they sent a petition to Jupiter asking for a king.

Jupiter saw what simple and foolish creatures they were, but to keep them quiet and make them think they had a king he threw down a huge log, which fell into the water with a great splash. The Frogs hid themselves among the reeds and grasses, thinking the new king to be some fearful giant. But they soon discovered how tame and peaceable King Log was. In a short time the younger Frogs were using him for a diving platform, while the older Frogs made him a meeting place, where they complained loudly to Jupiter about the government.

To teach the Frogs a lesson the ruler of the gods now sent a Crane to be king of Frogland. The Crane proved to be a very different sort of king from old King Log. He gobbled up the poor Frogs right and left and they soon saw what fools they had been. In mournful croaks they begged Jupiter to take away the cruel tyrant before they should all be destroyed.

"How now!" cried Jupiter "Are you not yet content? You have what you asked for and so you have only yourselves to blame for your misfortunes."

scenes.title: The Bored Frogs and Their Wish
scenes.english_text: The Frogs were tired of governing themselves. They had so much freedom that they did nothing but sit around croaking in a bored manner, wishing for a king who could rule them with royal pomp. So they sent a petition to Jupiter asking for a king.
scenes.tetum_translation: Iha mota laran, manduku sira baruk tebes atu ukun sira-nia an. Sira tuur de'it no manu-lia husu liurai ida ne'ebé bele ukun sira ho furak no kmanek. Nune'e, sira haruka husu ba maromak Júpiter atu fo liurai ida ba sira.

scenes.title: The Arrival of King Log
scenes.english_text: Jupiter saw how foolish they were, but to quiet them, he threw down a huge wooden log into the water with a great splash. The Frogs hid among the reeds, thinking their new king was a fearful giant.
scenes.tetum_translation: Maromak Júpiter haruka soe tiha ai-to'os boot ida ba bee laran no halo manan-bee boot ida. Manduku sira ta'uk no subar iha du'ut laran, tanba hanoin liurai foun ne'e kmaus makas no forte tebes.

scenes.title: Playing on King Log
scenes.english_text: They soon discovered how tame King Log was. Young Frogs used him as a diving platform, while older Frogs sat on him and complained to Jupiter that their king was too weak.
scenes.tetum_translation: Maibé lakteu sira haree katak Liurai Ai-To'os ne'e di'ak no la halo buat ida. Manduku ki'ik sira tuur iha nia leten hodi sori bee, no manduku katuas sira tuur ko'alia no kexa fali ba Júpiter tanba liurai ne'e kmaan demais.

scenes.title: The Cruel King Crane
scenes.english_text: To teach them a lesson, Jupiter sent a Crane to be their new king. The Crane was a very different king; he began gobbling up the poor Frogs one after another.
scenes.tetum_translation: Atu hanorin sira, Júpiter haruka fali manu-keta ida sai sira-nia liurai. Manu-keta ne'e oho no han manduku coitado sira ida-idak, no sira hahu ta'uk no mate wa'in.
